# Corpus comparison

<!-- Written by make comparison (tools/visual/comparison.py). Do not edit by hand. -->

Each drawing of the corpus in three renderings: LibreOffice, its PDF export; libvisio, the SVG of `vsd2xhtml` as it is in WeasyPrint 70.0; and weasyvsdx in WeasyPrint 70.0. All are PDFium rasterizations at 192 dpi, 2x the CSS px, cropped to the ink of the three, so they line up pixel for pixel. The mismatch comes from the bench, against the PNG export of LibreOffice, which is no exact reference for text. The Azure diagrams of the bench are not here: their icons may not be redistributed. Click a panel for its full size. The interactive page: <https://grigoriev.github.io/weasyvsdx/corpus/comparison.html>.
